description: This Java source file defines a class WebSocketRoute that sets up and handles WebSocket routes for the /ws endpoint in an Akka HTTP server. It manages WebSocket connection establishment, message handling, flow processing, protocol message extraction, signal building, and integration with streaming actors and configuration. The class supports authorization, message sniffing, signal enrichment, error handling, and rate limiting, tailored for a specialized web socket communication in the Eclipse Ditto project.
